race.comment: KODA MULWEE (1) is mixing form and out of the placings last time but was a Grade 5 winner three starts ago and moves to Box 1 this time where she has performed well. Can make amends this time. PARK KEY PAW (2) missed the frame last time but prior to that was an effortless Grade 5 winner (17.65) at this track, scoring by 2.25 lengths. Can find the frame this time. FABIO ZED (8) finished well back at this track last time when a 7 length fifth (17.61) but scored five back at this track (17.56). Goes very well from this draw with four wins and three minor placings from 10 starts. Worth following up. REMISSION RUN (7) was out of the money here last time out but can bounce back.
